prompt.alinti: This free tool clones any website, including all its code and images.
It grabs all the pages, JavaScript, CSS, and images from any site.
It also rewrites the links so everything works offline, just like you're browsing the live version.
It's a free alternative to HTTrack.
You just paste a URL into the web interface or run it locally with a couple of commands.
Great for researchers archiving sites or anyone who needs a copy of a website to work on offline.
Websitedownloader works with wget and archiver to download all websites assets and compress then sends it back to the user through socket channel.
Download the complete source code of any website (including all assets).

akis.ne: wget komutunun kullanıldığı parametreleri ekranda açıklayarak gösterir.

alinti: --mirror - Makes (among other things) the download recursive.
--convert-links - convert all the links (also to stuff like CSS stylesheets) to relative, so it will be suitable for offline viewing.
--page-requisites - Download things like CSS style-sheets and images required to properly display the page offline.
--no-parent - When recursing do not ascend to the parent directory. It is useful for restricting the download to only a portion of the site
--adjust-extension - Adds suitable extensions to filenames (html or css) depending on their content-type.

adimlar.ne: wget parametreleri kullanılarak indirme işlemi yapılır: --mirror, --convert-links, --page-requisites, --no-parent, --adjust-extension.
alinti: --convert-links - converts all links to relative for offline viewing.
--page-requisites - Downloads CSS, images, and other required assets.
--no-parent - Restricts download to a specific portion of the site.
